name: static-flow-boot
description: The boot of an app with offline support: the version check against the saved flow versions, then the config from the store or from /config, what is saved, and which paths the page cache serves afterwards. One static flow "main" (home and about pre-rendered, profile dynamic), as examples/server/static-flows.ts serves it with small pages.

cases.name: first online boot
cases.description: C14.1, C14.2. Nothing saved. /version is stale against the empty saved versions, so the whole /config is fetched and saved: its body text, the versions of the flows that have one, and the pre-rendered pages of the static flow. Right after the boot the static pages are served from the cache; the dynamic route and an unknown path are not.

cases.name: fresh: saved versions equal the remote ones
cases.description: C14.3. Every remote flow version equals the saved one: the saved config is the result and /config is not requested. Nothing is written. The pages are served from the store.

cases.name: fresh with no saved config
cases.description: C14.3. The versions match but no config text is saved: /config is fetched and everything is saved, as on a first boot.

cases.name: stale: a flow version moved
cases.description: C14.3. Saved main 3 (its pages: home only), remote main 4: the whole /config is fetched and saved again; the pages of main are replaced by the new ones, so about is now served.

cases.name: offline with a saved config
cases.description: C14.1, C14.2. A cold start after one online boot, the network off (/version fails to connect): the saved config is the result, nothing is requested after /version and nothing is written. Static pages, visited or not, are served from the store; profile is not.

cases.name: offline is any /version failure, an error status too
cases.description: C14.2. There is no connectivity check: any /version failure, here a 500, is the offline boot. The saved config is the result.

cases.name: offline with nothing saved
cases.description: C14.2, C14.5. /version fails and no config is saved: the boot fails with this exact message (orca_app.dart preload) and nothing is written.

result.error: No network and no cached config available

cases.name: force update wins over a stale version
cases.description: C14.5. /version says forceUpdate: the result is forceUpdate, whatever the versions say (main moved from 3 to 4 here). /config is not requested and nothing is written.

cases.name: cleanup: a versioned flow gone from the refetched config
cases.description: C14.4. Saved versions {main: 4, old: 2} with the pages of both; remote {main: 5} and a /config without old: the pages of old are deleted and the versions are {main: 5}.

cases.name: an unversioned flow gone from the config keeps its pages
cases.description: C14.4. Cleanup walks the saved versions, which hold only flows that had a version. The static flow legacy never had one, so when it is gone from the refetched config its pages stay in the store. They are not served: the cache only looks in the flows of the config.

cases.name: a dynamic route is never served, even with a saved page
cases.description: C14.4. The server leaves dynamic routes out of pages; the client also keeps the set of dynamic paths of the static flows and never serves them. Here the store holds a page for profile (as if saved before the route turned dynamic) and the config marks profile dynamic: it is not served.

cases.name: the cache reads the saved pages, not the pages inside the config
cases.description: C14.1. Offline, the saved config carries home and about in its pages but the store's pages of main hold home only: about is not served. The page cache reads orca_pages_<flow>, never the pages of the config.

cases.name: quirk: an unversioned flow keeps the boot stale
cases.description: C14.3, Flutter's quirk, pinned as Flutter does it. /version lists every flow, an unversioned one as 0, but only flows with a version are saved, and a missing saved version differs from 0. So an app with an unversioned flow (extra here) is stale on every launch: /config is fetched each time and the saved versions stay {main: 4}.

cases.name: a stale boot whose /config fails does not fall back
cases.description: C14.3, C14.5. Stale (saved main 3, remote 4) and /config answers 500: the boot fails with the client's error for that status. The saved config is not used and nothing is written.
